name: agentcast
description: Stream your Claude Code session to a shareable live link. Viewers watch prompts, replies, tool calls and diffs as they happen, then replay when it ends.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: agentcast server to stream to. Leave empty for the hosted service at https://agentcast.agentcast.workers.dev

passphrase.title: Viewer passphrase
passphrase.description: If set, viewers must enter this before anything loads. Leave empty for link-only access.

ai_summary.title: AI title and summary
ai_summary.description: When a session ends, generate a short title and summary with Workers AI (on by default).

enabled.title: Streaming enabled
enabled.description: Turn off to stop streaming without uninstalling (on by default).
